svg.title: What a TCP Black-Car Credential and Cover Cost Up Front
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-tcp-credential-cover-stack; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: What a TCP Black-Car Credential and Cover Cost Up Front; subtitle: Khushnud Numonov's EPN, TCP filing, commercial premium, and card fee; caption: The TCP belongs inside an LLC or corporation and dies on sequencing errors; the bigger bill is the commercial premium, which Khushnud Numonov paid upfront on a 0 percent APR card instead of a 23.8 percent APR loan.; assumptions note: Bucket figures are as reported by Khushnud Numonov; the total range is the arithmetic sum of the buckets, with the low end on Class B and the high end on Class A. Airport permits are excluded because no cost was given.; note: Khushnud Numonov (67saVKNzHxc @ 00:07:16, 67saVKNzHxc @ 00:10:24, IqvMzwtwzrI @ 00:05:26, IqvMzwtwzrI @ 00:10:07).; total range: About $9,516 to $10,016; buckets: label: DMV EPN; low: 15; high: 15; notes: About $15, takes one to two weeks, and stalls the TCP portal until it clears.; label: TCP filing fee; low: 1000; high: 1500; notes: $1,000 Class B with a 125-mile limit; $1,500 Class A for unlimited runs.; label: Uber Black sedan commercial premium; low: 8161; high: 8161; notes: Lancer Insurance cash price per year; financing meant $2,155 down and 23.8% APR.; label: Card fee to pay the premium upfront; low: 340; high: 340; notes: Offset by $170 cash back, saving about $441 versus the financed loan.
